name: shopify-mcp-server
description: Universal read-only MCP for Shopify Admin GraphQL API 2026-04. 6 tools cover 100% of the read surface. Multi-store support via SHOPIFY_STORES JSON.
long_description: 6 universal tools: shopify_list_stores, shopify_graphql_query, shopify_graphql_introspect, shopify_bulk_query, shopify_bulk_poll, shopify_shopifyql. Covers 100% of the Shopify Admin GraphQL read surface (products, orders, customers, inventory, fulfillments, discounts, metafields, metaobjects, analytics, bulk exports). Read-only enforced at the query parser level via graphql-core; only bulkOperationCancel is permitted as a mutation. Multi-store: pass SHOPIFY_STORES as a JSON object mapping alias → {domain, client_id, client_secret} (or {domain, access_token}). Single-store fallback via SHOPIFY_DOMAIN + SHOPIFY_CLIENT_ID/SECRET or SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN. Supports both Dev Dashboard custom apps (client_credentials OAuth, 24h tokens auto-refreshed) and legacy pre-2026 custom apps (shpat_ tokens). Cost-based throttle aware per store.

tools.name: shopify_list_stores
tools.description: List all Shopify stores configured for this agent (alias, domain, auth mode). Call first.

tools.name: shopify_graphql_query
tools.description: Execute a read-only GraphQL query against the Shopify Admin API. Mutations rejected by parser.

tools.name: shopify_graphql_introspect
tools.description: Introspect the Admin GraphQL schema — full catalog or a single type.

tools.name: shopify_bulk_query
tools.description: Launch an async bulk export of a read-only GraphQL query. Returns a BulkOperation ID.

tools.name: shopify_bulk_poll
tools.description: Poll a BulkOperation by ID for status + download URL.

tools.name: shopify_shopifyql
tools.description: Run a ShopifyQL analytics query (SQL-like, requires read_reports).

shopify_stores.title: Stores (JSON, multi-store)
shopify_stores.description: JSON object mapping alias → store config, e.g. {"main":{"domain":"x.myshopify.com","client_id":"...","client_secret":"..."},"outlet":{"domain":"y.myshopify.com","access_token":"shpat_..."}}. Alternative to the single-store fields below.

shopify_shop_domain.title: Shop Domain (single-store)
shopify_shop_domain.description: Admin domain in format '<shop>.myshopify.com' (NOT the custom storefront domain). Ignored if SHOPIFY_STORES is set.

shopify_client_id.title: Client ID (Dev Dashboard)
shopify_client_id.description: Dev Dashboard custom-app Client ID. Required unless SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN is provided.

shopify_client_secret.title: Client Secret (Dev Dashboard)
shopify_client_secret.description: Dev Dashboard custom-app Client Secret. Required unless SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN is provided.

shopify_access_token.title: Admin API Access Token (legacy)
shopify_access_token.description: Pre-2026 legacy custom-app token (shpat_...). Alternative to Client ID/Secret.
